classification.difficultyReason: Unsignposted multi-step problem: scale the job by area, use inverse proportion of workers to days to find the workers needed, then convert to cost. Same demand as p25-q10.

content.prompt:
It takes 4 workers one day to lay 60 m² of paving.
A council wants a plaza with an area of $480\text{ m}^2$ paved in 4 days.
It hires enough workers to finish on time and pays each of them $\$210$ per day.
How much will it cost the council?

answer.worked:
The plaza is $480\div60=8$ times the area, so 4 workers would take 8 days. Let $t$ be the time in days and $N$ the number of workers for the whole plaza.

$$\begin{align*}t&=\frac{k}{N}\\8&=\frac{k}{4}\\k&=32\\t&=\frac{32}{N}\\4&=\frac{32}{N}\\N&=8\end{align*}$$

The total cost is

$$\begin{align*}C&=8\times4\times210\\C&=6720.\end{align*}$$

It will cost $\$6720$.
